payload.title: A workspace always keeps an owner
payload.context: Security review of M3 (#16): the last owner could delete their account, leaving a workspace nobody can manage, and first-run setup reopened when no workspace existed.
payload.rationale: An ownerless workspace cannot be recovered through the UI, and a reopened setup lets a stranger claim the instance.
payload.consequences: The last owner cannot delete their account; setup counts as complete when a workspace or a user exists.
